author: ValWood
body:
Hi @sandraorchard 

71 mitochondrial subunits are annotated with NAS to mitochondrial inner membrane.

from PMID:18245278

We wouldn't make this annotation because although the mitochondria are localized to  the inner membrane for insertion, they are not part of the inner membrane but are tethered to it by other gene products  (i.e oxa1 insertase, or the mito receptor Mba1)

thanks

val
